# AI Product Launch Checklist: A Complete Automated Launch Workflow

## Why Product Launches Need a System

A standard product launch involves 20-30 independent tasks: copywriting, asset creation, social media预热, email sequences, pricing configuration, documentation updates, and analytics setup. Miss any one and your launch results suffer. Most teams lack a standardized process. This guide breaks the launch into a complete AI-automated checklist from T-30 to T+14.

## Phase 1: Pre-Launch (T-30 to T-7)

### Task 1: Define Launch Goals and KPIs
Use ChatGPT or Claude to define success metrics. Sample output: first-week registrations 1,000+, conversion rate 5%+, social reach 50,000+ impressions, NPS at Day 7.

### Task 2: Competitive Analysis
Use Perplexity or Gemini to analyze competitor launch timing, messaging, channels, and reception.

### Tasks 3-4: Asset Inventory and Copy Generation
Use Claude to generate a complete asset inventory. Use Jasper or Copy.ai for landing page copy, social posts, email sequences, and press releases.

### Task 5: AI Visual Assets
Use Midjourney for product concept art. Canva AI for standardized posts in required dimensions. Runway or Pika for short demo videos.

## Phase 2: Launch Countdown (T-7 to T-0)

### Task 6: Social Media Scheduling
Use Buffer or Hypefury with this cadence: T-7 teaser, T-5 feature preview, T-3 testimonials, T-1 countdown, T-0 launch announcement.

### Task 7: Automated Email Sequence
Use ConvertKit or Mailchimp for 5 emails: T-3 teaser, T-1 countdown, T+0 announcement, T+3 onboarding, T+7 feedback. AI generates drafts and optimizes subject lines.

### Task 8: Technical Preparation
Checklist includes: landing page tested, pricing configured, payment flow tested, API docs updated, analytics verified, error pages customized, SSL valid, load tested. Use BrowserStack for visual testing, Lighthouse CI for performance.

## Phase 3: Launch Day (T+0)

### Task 9: Real-Time Monitoring
Use Meter or Datadog for a dashboard with business metrics (real-time signups, revenue), technical metrics (CPU, error rate, page load), and social metrics (impressions, sentiment). AI alerts: error rate over 1% notifies, server load over 80% auto-scales.

### Task 10: Multi-Platform Publishing
One action publishes to Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Product Hunt. AI adapts content per platform, monitors comments, and generates reply drafts.

## Phase 4: Post-Launch (T+1 to T+14)

### Task 11: 24-Hour Review
AI generates a report with KPI achievement, anomalies, and recommended actions.

### Task 12: User Behavior Analysis (Day 7)
Use Amplitude or Mixpanel to track activation rate, Day 7 retention, feature adoption, and conversion rate. AI identifies behavior clusters and predicts final conversion rates.

### Task 13: Feedback Collection
Day 3: auto-send NPS survey. AI analyzes free-text responses for sentiment, extracts top 5 issues, and generates a product improvement priority matrix.

### Task 14: Launch Retrospective (Day 14)
AI generates a comprehensive report: core metrics vs targets, pre vs post launch comparison, key findings, and action items.

## Conclusion

A successful product launch is about systems and execution. This AI-powered checklist transforms launches from stressful gambles into predictable processes. Action today: copy this checklist into Notion and start executing three weeks before your next launch.
